q:fn:plusDays.code: function plusDays(s,days){ if(!s) return ''; let d; if(typeof s==='string'){ const m=s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); if(m) d=new Date(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]); } if(!d) d=new Date(s); if(isNaN(d.getTime())) return ''; d.setDate(d.getDate()+days); const y=d.getFullYear(),mo=String(d.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),da=String(d.getDate()).padStart(2,'0'); return y+'-'+mo+'-'+da; }

q:fn:fmtDate.code: function fmtDate(s){ if(!s) return ''; if(typeof s==='string'){ const m=s.match(/^(\d{4})-(\d{2})-(\d{2})$/); if(m) return new Date(+m[1],+m[2]-1,+m[3]).toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'}); } const d=new Date(s); if(isNaN(d.getTime())) return ''; return d.toLocaleDateString('en-US',{month:'short',day:'numeric',year:'numeric'}); }

index:fn:applyAreaQty.code: function applyAreaQty(uomTarget,sIdx){if(sIdx==null)sIdx=_qbActiveSec();const inputId=(uomTarget==='SqYd'?'qb-area-sqyd-':'qb-area-sqft-')+sIdx;const fbId=uomTarget==='SqYd'?'qb-area-sqyd':'qb-area-sqft';const el=document.getElementById(inputId)||document.getElementById(fbId);const qty=parseFloat((el||{}).value)||0;if(!qty)return alert('Enter a value first.');if(window._qb){if(!Array.isArray(window._qb.sections))window._qb.sections=[{title:'Materials & Labor'}];if(!window._qb.sections[sIdx])window._qb.sections[sIdx]={title:'Section '+(sIdx+1)};if(uomTarget==='SqFt')window._qb.sections[sIdx]._areaSqFt=qty;else window._qb.sections[sIdx]._areaSqYd=qty;}let matFilled=0,labFilled=0,maxMatQty=qty;(window._qb&&window._qb.materials||[]).forEach((m,i)=>{if((m._section||0)!==sIdx)return;const uom=(m.costUOM||m.coverageUOM||m.purchaseUOM||'').trim();if(uom===uomTarget){const cov=Number(m.coveragePerUOM)||0;let finalQty;if(cov>1&&qty>0){const cartons=Math.ceil(qty/cov);finalQty=Math.round(cartons*cov*100)/100;}else{finalQty=qty;}window._qb.materials[i].quantity=finalQty;if(finalQty>maxMatQty)maxMatQty=finalQty;matFilled++;}});(window._qb&&window._qb.labors||[]).forEach((l,i)=>{if((l._section||0)!==sIdx)return;const uom=(l.uom||'').trim();if(uom===uomTarget){window._qb.labors[i].quantity=qty;labFilled++;}});const total=matFilled+labFilled;if(total===0){showToast(`No materials or labor items with UOM "${uomTarget}" found in this section.`);return;}const parts=[];if(matFilled)parts.push(`${matFilled} material${matFilled===1?'':'s'}`);if(labFilled)parts.push(`${labFilled} labor item${labFilled===1?'':'s'}`);showToast(`✓ Applied ${qty} ${uomTarget} to ${parts.join(' + ')}`);renderView();if(matFilled>0&&labFilled>0&&maxMatQty>qty){setTimeout(()=>openLaborRoundupModal(qty,maxMatQty,uomTarget),120);}}

index:fn:roundupLaborQty.code: function roundupLaborQty(newQty,uom){if(!window._qb)return;let updated=0;(window._qb.labors||[]).forEach((l,i)=>{if((l.uom||'').trim()===uom){window._qb.labors[i].quantity=newQty;updated++;}});if(window._qb){if(uom==='SqFt')window._qb._labAreaSqFt=newQty;else if(uom==='SqYd')window._qb._labAreaSqYd=newQty;}closeModal();showToast(`✓ Labor rounded up to ${newQty} ${uom} on ${updated} item${updated===1?'':'s'}`);renderView();}

if(newStatus==='site_survey_scheduled'&&!l.siteSurveyDate){showToast('📐 Set a site-survey date on the card first — that auto-moves it here.','warning');return;}if(newStatus==='approved'){const ok=confirm(`Move ${l.name} to Approved? index:fn:changeLeadStatus.code: function changeLeadStatus(id,status){const l=getLead(id);if(!l)return;const oldStatus=l.status;l.status=status;l.stageChangedAt=_todayISO();if(oldStatus!==status){addActivity(`Lead ${l.number} → ${LEAD_STATUS_LABELS[status]}`);if(typeof _ensureTaskForLeadStage==='function')_ensureTaskForLeadStage(l,status);}if(status==='approved'&&!l.convertedCustomerId){const cu={id:'c'+Date.now(),type:l.type||'Retail',name:l.name,phone:l.phone,email:l.email,address:l.address,source:l.source,customerSince:_todayISO(),salesRepId:l.salesRepId||'',contacts:Array.isArray(l.contacts)?JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(l.contacts)):[],notes:[],convertedFromLeadId:l.id};data.customers.push(cu);l.convertedCustomerId=cu.id;addActivity(`${l.name} converted to customer`)}saveData();if(typeof refreshLeadKanban==='function')refreshLeadKanban();else renderView();}
